title: No-Show Deposit Treaty Lab
oneLiner: Salons, clinics, tutors, and repair shops test deposit and reminder policies without making good customers feel punished.
targetUser: Appointment-based small businesses considering deposits, card-on-file, cancellation fees, or SMS reminders.
keyUX: Compare policy options, preview customer wording, tag repeat offenders, and generate a fair no-show treaty plus reminder cadence.
sourceSignalReferences: S8: Small businesses ask how to reduce no-shows without pressuring customers - https://www.reddit.com/r/smallbusiness/comments/1tz6m53/how_do_you_reduce_noshows_for_service/
S9: Operators quantify cancelled bookings and no-show loss - https://www.reddit.com/r/smallbusiness/comments/1uqg9ua/how_much_you_are_losing_to_cancelled_bookings_no/
twist: Tests the social tone of deposit rules, not just an internal recovery dashboard.
smallGroupFit: A solo service operator can run it before changing booking terms and angering regulars.
spreadTrigger: The treaty copy is easy to paste into booking pages, text reminders, and staff scripts.
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web app called "No-Show Deposit Treaty Lab" for appointment-based small businesses. Include a no-show loss calculator, deposit/card-on-file policy comparison, customer comfort preview, repeat-offender lane, SMS reminder timeline, exception rules, and a customer-friendly no-show treaty export. Design direction: use the calm-consumer profile with warm policy language, low-stress warnings, plain scheduling cards, and a reassuring service-business tone.
